mapper.sql: from merchant_chapter_offer o join mms_merchant mm on mm.member_id = o.merchant_id and mm.status = 1 and (mm.account_status is null or mm.account_status != 2) and (mm.del_flag is null or mm.del_flag != 2) join registration_entitlement e on e.topic_id = o.topic_id and e.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and e.status in (0, 1) join cms_registration r on r.id = e.registration_id and r.owner_type = 2 and r.purchase_kind = 3 and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 left join cms_topic_node n on n.topic_id = o.topic_id and n.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and n.merchant_member_id = o.merchant_id left join player_node_progress p on p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.topic_id = o.topic_id and p.node_id = n.id and p.checkin_time is not null and p.del_flag = 0 left join redemption rd on rd.registration_id = r.id and rd.topic_id = o.topic_id and rd.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and rd.merchant_id = o.merchant_id and rd.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
select e.registration_id, r.member_id, min(p.checkin_time) checkin_at, min(rd.create_time) redeemed_at
where o.merchant_id = #{merchantMemberId} and o.status = 1 and r.create_time >= #{since} group by e.registration_id, e.chapter_id, r.member_id

select distinct m.id member_id, m.sex, m.birthday, pg.level lvl, mip.category_weights_json
join ums_member m on m.id = r.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 left join player_growth pg on pg.member_id = m.id left join member_interest_profile mip on mip.member_id = m.id where o.merchant_id = #{merchantMemberId} and o.status = 1 and (p.checkin_time >= #{since} or rd.create_time >= #{since})

select t.name topic_name, o.quota_total, o.quota_used from merchant_chapter_offer o join cms_topic t on t.id = o.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 where o.merchant_id = #{merchantMemberId} and o.status = 1 and (o.valid_end is null or o.valid_end > now())

select count(*) from tms_browse_record b where b.browse_type = 1 and b.browse_time >= #{since} and b.target_id in ( select distinct n.topic_id from cms_topic_node n where n.merchant_member_id = #{merchantMemberId})

select count(distinct b.member_id) from tms_browse_record b where b.browse_type = 1 and b.browse_time >= #{since} and b.target_id in ( select distinct n.topic_id from cms_topic_node n where n.merchant_member_id = #{merchantMemberId})

select r.member_id, m.nickname, m.avatar, t.name topic_name, min(p.checkin_time) checkin_at, min(rd.create_time) redeemed_at
join ums_member m on m.id = r.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 join cms_topic t on t.id = o.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 where o.merchant_id = #{merchantMemberId} and o.status = 1 and (p.checkin_time is not null or rd.id is not null) group by e.registration_id, e.chapter_id, r.member_id, m.nickname, m.avatar, t.name
